verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Terraform provider or an equivalent infrastructure-as-code tool for managing Entra apps, groups and policies. The Microsoft Graph API, its OData/OpenAPI metadata and Graph Explorer are developer building blocks a team could use to construct IaC tooling. They are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit, and the IaC axis does apply to an IdP.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
